mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling the gas envelope was most worthwhile: it explained why losing energy lets a core gather more gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: Gathering rock and volatiles into the later core felt relatively predictable after the chapter introduced the timing contrast.

surprise.text: I had not expected an envelope to need to lose energy and contract before it could accumulate more gas.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly purposeless, though using open space as the cooling ingredient was an abstraction.

continue.text: Yes. The contrast between the two formation paths made me curious about how the story connects these worlds to the later solar system.
